items.summary: Tung's voter pamphlet statement says he will protect a balanced budget; his site lists maintaining a structurally balanced budget, building reserves in line with best practices and planning ahead for the sunset of the Prop G educator parcel tax.

citations.quote: I will protect a balanced budget, deliver on the student assignment system, and insist on transparent data.

citations.quote: maintaining a structurally balanced budget, building reserves in line with best practices, planning ahead for the sunset of the Prop G educator parcel tax, and looking past polished administrative reports to the actual data.

items.summary: Tung's voter pamphlet statement says he will deliver on the student assignment system; his site says he would examine the district's enrollment simulations, fix technical bottlenecks and keep the transition to a zone-based system from being delayed further.
items.title: Keep the move to a zone-based assignment system from stalling

citations.quote: I will protect a balanced budget, deliver on the student assignment system, and insist on transparent data.
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 31 (PDF page 33)

citations.quote: As a data scientist and parent leader, I’ll dig into the District’s enrollment simulations, fix the technical bottlenecks, and make sure this transition doesn’t stall any further.
citations.locator: Issues: A Student Assignment System That Works for Families

items.summary: Tung's voter pamphlet statement says he will insist on transparent data; his site says he will insist on cohort-level performance data that parents and the board can see.
items.title: Insist on transparent, cohort-level performance data

citations.quote: I will protect a balanced budget, deliver on the student assignment system, and insist on transparent data.
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 31 (PDF page 33)

citations.quote: I’ll insist on transparent, cohort-level performance data so parents and the Board can see what’s really happening in our schools.
citations.locator: Issues: Better Outcomes for Every Student

items.summary: Tung's site says he will push to expand dedicated intervention time such as WIN blocks and high-impact literacy tutoring in high-needs schools.
items.title: Expand intervention time (WIN blocks) and literacy tutoring in high-needs schools

citations.quote: I’ll champion expanding what’s already working: dedicated intervention time like WIN blocks that give students targeted support at no additional instructional cost, high-impact literacy tutoring in high-needs schools, and more capacity in the programs families are lining up for, like language immersion and advanced coursework.
citations.locator: Issues: Better Outcomes for Every Student

items.summary: Tung's site says he would add capacity in programs families seek, such as language immersion and advanced coursework, including by expanding immersion seats to grow enrollment.
items.title: Expand seats in language immersion and advanced coursework

citations.quote: Growing enrollment, including by expanding seats in immersion programs families are actively seeking out, makes the entire district stronger and more financially secure.
citations.locator: Issues: A Student Assignment System That Works for Families

citations.quote: more capacity in the programs families are lining up for, like language immersion and advanced coursework.
citations.locator: Issues: Better Outcomes for Every Student

items.summary: As chair of San Francisco's Citizens' General Obligation Bond Oversight Committee, signed the letter presenting its Fiscal Year 2024-25 report (December 2025) to the Mayor and Board of Supervisors and wrote its liaison report on the 2014 and 2020 Earthquake Safety and Emergency Response bonds, which states he believes the proceeds are being spent consistently with the original authorizations; no measured outcome recorded as of 2026-11-09.
items.title: Chair's letter and ESER liaison report in the bond oversight committee's FY2024-25 report

citations.quote: Dear Mayor Lurie and Members of the Board of Supervisors: On behalf of my fellow members, I am pleased to present to you the Report of the Citizens’ General Obligation Bond Oversight Committee (CGOBOC). This report covers Fiscal Year 2024-2025 (FY25).
citations.locator: p. 3, letter signed by Tim Tung, Chair

citations.quote: 2020 AND 2014 EARTHQUAKE SAFETY & EMERGENCY RESPONSE BONDS Report by Tim Tung
Based on my research, discussions with staff, and tours of the facilities, I believe that the bond proceeds are being spent in a manner consistent with the original authorizations.
